note: The rain the radars of Météo-France measured, over metropolitan France (the areas the radars do not see are transparent): the rain accumulated over the 5 minutes before each image, shown as intensity classes (`legend`). An image is published about two minutes after its date and drawn by a gateway of this project; the tiles are not a forecast. **Not for safety.**
